text: {"lessons":["I have repeatedly sold Stock A and E at gains, but being above my average cost is not by itself a reason to sell; I should base trades on expected risk and return.","I should assess the portfolio as a whole rather than treating each stock as a separate account or letting the satisfaction of locking in gains drive decisions.","Because price changes are random and past moves do not predict future ones, I should avoid reacting to short-term fluctuations and follow a disciplined, diversified plan."]}
